{"id":1888705980,"question_id":4067,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"6 months","timestamp":1768726003,"status":14,"status_display":"Time Limit Exceeded","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1888705980/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Design Auction System","memory":"N/A","code":"class AuctionSystem {\npublic:\n    unordered_map<int , unordered_map<int,int>>mp;\n    //itemId -> [userId -> bidamount]\n    AuctionSystem() {\n    }\n    \n    void addBid(int userId, int itemId, int bidAmount) {\n        mp[itemId][userId] = bidAmount;\n    }\n    \n    void updateBid(int userId, int itemId, int newAmount) {\n        mp[itemId][userId] = newAmount;\n    }\n    \n    void removeBid(int userId, int itemId) {\n        if(!mp.count(itemId)) return;\n\n        mp[itemId].erase(userId);\n        if(mp[itemId].empty()) mp.erase(itemId);\n    }\n    \n    int getHighestBidder(int itemId) {\n        int biggestamt = -1;\n        int biggestuser = -1;\n\n        auto map = mp[itemId];\n        for(auto x : map)\n        {   \n            auto[user , amount] = x;\n            if(amount > biggestamt)\n            {\n                biggestamt = amount;\n                biggestuser = user;\n            } \n            else if(amount == biggestamt) \n            {\n                if(user > biggestuser) biggestuser = user;\n            }\n        }\n        return biggestuser;\n    }\n};\n\n/**\n * Your AuctionSystem object will be instantiated and called as such:\n * AuctionSystem* obj = new AuctionSystem();\n * obj->addBid(userId,itemId,bidAmount);\n * obj->updateBid(userId,itemId,newAmount);\n * obj->removeBid(userId,itemId);\n * int param_4 = obj->getHighestBidder(itemId);\n */","compare_result":"","title_slug":"design-auction-system","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1508}
